outcome_definition_rationale: anchor_relative counts PDR eyes missed by the deployed anchor that the partner catches. The v4 pair_min outcome measures gain over the better of the two readers, which penalises a partner stronger than the anchor by construction and so biases the decision-relevant secondary against best_partner_marginal.
reason: The v4 power expectation used between-pair reliability of C, whereas the primary is a within-anchor rank correlation; used C reliability in place of outcome reliability; and hardcoded implied requirements (25,000 patients for 0.90; patient axis satisfied) that the v4 run itself contradicts.

corrected_power_expectation.interpretation: Expected observed effect is below the detection threshold. A null is a power statement and does not rule out a relationship of the size v3 implies.

pseudo_confirmation_preview_estimation_o.note: Split-half within the estimation pool: predictor on one half, outcome on the other. Recorded before confirmation as the empirical expectation.

best_partner_marginal_seed_agreement_not.interpretation: best_partner_marginal picks the same partner for nearly every anchor, so its seed agreement is all-or-nothing and the 0.10 chance line does not apply. Three different top models across three seeds accounts for the v4 figure of 0.000.
